title: GAN designs nanobody CDR3 sequences; two of ten neutralize Omicron RBD in vitro
summary: A GAN named AiCDR generated about 10,000 nanobody CDR3 sequences, which were grafted onto a humanized scaffold and structurally modelled, giving about 5200 high-confidence models used for epitope profiling across six targets. Of ten nanobodies designed against the SARS-CoV-2 Omicron RBD, two showed detectable neutralization in vitro. The hit rate is low, and the abstract reports no affinity or in vivo data.
ai_technology: Generative adversarial network (AiCDR) generating CDR3 sequences, with structure prediction and epitope profiling

evidence.tested: Ten designed nanobodies were tested for neutralization of SARS-CoV-2 Omicron RBD in vitro.
evidence.unknown: Binding affinity, specificity and in vivo activity of the two active nanobodies; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: A GAN generated candidate nanobody CDR3 sequences that fed the design library.
